header_desc: Izincwadi zevangeli ze-Gnostic ezibhaliwe eminyakeni engama-2000 edlule, zinegugu lokuthi ziwumgogodla ohlangothini lwezemfundo yonke: ubunzima bokuphila, okukhombisa ukuthi ukuqonda kwabantu kuyinxenye ebalulekile ye-universe enkulu: I-EGO eliyingqayizivele inemitha futhi idala umfanekiso wesikhathi-material; ukuze siwuphakamise, i-cosmos inikeza iConciencia Universal, engapheli kwesikhathi futhi engathathi ndawo: u-UNO, oholwa — olandelwa ngenhliziyo — okusivumela ukuba siqhakazise isithombe somphakathi.
left_title: Ukuhamba kweSophia: Usuka ePrison yeYaldabaoth uya eMhlabeni Wokukhanya
left_body: Kwi-relativity ejwayelekile, impahla ibonisa isikhathi-ukwakha ukuthi ibhukuthe kwaye isikhathi-ukwakha sichaza impahla ukuthi ihambe. Ngendlela efanayo, i-ego inokuthula futhi ibonisa ubunzima bayo: ubuningi bayo buhlekisa ukwakheka kwakho ngaphakathi futhi buhweba ngomfanekiso wesikhathi nempahla ye psyche 🧠. Ngakho, kuphela ngokuhlakanipha kukaSophia singenza ukuqonda ukuthi umyalezo ``uBaba naye singabanye'' uyafana nokuqedela ``u-ego ongenamkhawulo'' ukuze sibuye siye eMhlaba wokukhanya okuhlanzekile lapho uBaba Ongabonakali. : izimo ezingapheli kwesikhathi nezangempela ze-pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Ukuqonda ukuthi ukufa akupheli ngokuphelele, kepha kuyiguquko kusikhulula kwi-ignorance. E-hemisphere engemuva, i-pneuma yethu ihlale ngaphansi kwesikhathi-nokubaluleka, uMkhawulo wefrekhensi ephezulu | 999⟩. Lapha kukhona umhlaba wokuhlangana nenkululeko (Izehlakalo Eningi).
center_text: I-Pistis Sophia kanye ne-demiurge Yaldabaoth: ukuqonda kuveza phakathi kwezimo ezimbili ezibalulekile — umoya |UNO⟩ ❤️ kanye nophenyo |EGO⟩ 🧠—. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukhetho lokukhululeka kuyimpahla eyisisekelo yemakhono, engathwali odumo noma imikhuba yokholo, okungafinyelelwa njengomkhiqizo omkhulu ⟨UNO|EGO⟩.
universe_mat_text: Umzimba wesintu wenziwe ngomsoco we-carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). E-hemisphere engemuva, kunomkhawulo wesikhathi-nokweqile, ubukhulu befrekhensi ephansi | 666⟩. Amandla we-gravitational asithwala endaweni lapho: <q>impi iyithuba, inkululeko iwukuhlukunyezwa, kanti ukungazi yilo amandla</q> (1984).
final_quote: Uhlaka ┻ lapho uphumula 🧠 luneziphango ezivulekile. Udinga kuphela ukushintsha imephu ✝️ ukuze uvuke ❤️
p2_sub: ICondor noNdlovu: Uhambo lwesayensi kanye nokukholelwa
cap1_title: Isahluko 1: Iphrofethi yeKondor noNdlovu footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Umqondo neframework ye-integration: ukuhamba phakathi kokuhlakanipha okuqondile kwaseNingizimu (inhliziyo, ulwazi lwemvelo nempilo) kanye nokuqhamuka kwezenhlalo kwaseNyakatho (ukuhlakanipha, isayensi nokuqonda). Ukulawulwa kwezinga lokukhalipha ukuze uqale ukuqhuma kwezenzakalo futhi udlule isimo sokudida.
cap2_desc: Uhlangothi olubalulekile lwezokufunda: Ukuhlakanipha Kwenyangazayo nhlobo Phansi. Kungani imithetho kaNewton noMaxwell ingafaki phakathi nesikhathi esiphakeme, ukuhlukana kokuphila kwe-Einstein kanye nokukhubazeka kwesikhathi njengethuluzi lokucabanga.
cap3_desc: Ukuhlangana kwemibono yeFaggin--Segarra: umzimba njengesitimela esiqhuba ngenkambu ye-quantum esiqonde ngaphandle kwesikhathi-nokwezikhathi, lapho kuhlala khona iziqu. Ukuqonda akuveli emkhakheni kodwa kudlula, kuhlanganisa neNhliziyo yokuqala kanye noMklamo oluhlakaniphile ongen kwesikhathi nendawo.
cap4_desc: Umphumela weNag Hammadi (1945) kanye nalokho akukhumbulayo: uzwe olwakhiwe kube umsebenzi omusha, hhayi njengendawo yokuhlala, kodwa njengokukhalipha komoya. Umyalezo ovela ku-evangelical yeTomas (Logion 3): uJesu akazange azeze ngezenhlalakahle eziphakanyisiwe, kodwa wethula ukufaka ukukhanya kungakaze kube yi-‘Demiurge’ ngenkumbulo (gnosis).
cap5_title: Isahluko 5: IThala leMoya kanye nePrison yeDemiurge (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: I-Demiurge Yaldabaoth — futhi ibizwa ngokuthi umqondisi omkhulu we-material — ungumdidiyeli wezwe elibukwayo, uNkulunkulu othathe umakhono wombuso, owazi amakhono angempela. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, uSophia uhlaselwe ngaphansi ngaphansi kobunzima bempahla, ehamba phambili ukwehla kohlanga olukhulekwayo.
cap6_desc: I-eschatology eyahlabelela nokuphazamiseka kokubona: umfanekiso weDajjal nendaba yokubhalwa emoyeni (umfula ne-ugqozi). Umgomo wezobuchwepheshe obahlosiwe (1984) njengokugcineka kwengqondo ye-ego, ngokumelene nomyalezo ophikako kaJesu ophonsa umgomo wokuphuma kwentela.
cap7_desc: Umphumela, iparadox enkulu incike phezulu: emhlabeni omkhulu we cosmos — nezinkanyezi ezingaphezu kwezimbili — lapho kwenza khona ukuthi ibhodi uJesu: “uBaba naye ube awakhe”. Ngabe lokhu kukhona umyalezo oyimfihlo ngohlangothi olubanzi phakathi kwabantu ne cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>Umqondo wokuthi uNkulunkulu ungumuntu omhlophe, mkhulu kakhulukazi, onebhadi lengubo, ehlezi ezulwini futhi ebala ukuwa kwesipahi sasinye, uyahlekisa. Kodwa uma uNkulunkulu ethathwa njengokuhlanganiswa kwemithetho ye-physics elawulwa yi-universe, khona-ke ngempela kukhona lowoNkulunkulu. Nokho, loNkulunkulu udinga ukuphendulwa ngendlela eyodwa... ayinayo imisebenzi ethile yokuphendula kumthetho we-gravity</q>
